Team — looping you in to lock the dayflow. Sophie sent availability; Lucy prefers system design early.

High-level ask: can the panel run as a compact half-day (4 x 45m interviews + 1 x 30m PM) with a 60m lunch/buffer? Proposed sequence (first pass):
- 9:30–10:15 — System design (Karthik)
- 10:25–11:10 — Pair programming (Logan)
- 11:20–12:05 — Product sense / PM (Laura) — 30m OK
- 12:05–13:05 — Lunch / buffer (candidate needs at least 45m)
- 13:05–13:50 — Services/infra deep-dive (Monica)

Proposed debrief: quick 15–20m synchronous notes + 30m async rubric completion by EOD. I've attached a draft slot matrix and panel roles doc — please review conflicts and confirm who will take debrief ownership.

If that order doesn't work, tell me swaps and preferred buffer windows. I want to finalize invites by EOD so Sophie/Lucy can confirm travel to the time zone.

Thanks —
Marissa

On Mon, May 4, 2027 at 9:50 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — looping you in to lock the dayflow.

Thanks for the plan. A couple of practical notes from the hiring-side:
- I'd prefer system design first (agree with Lucy's preference) but extend that to 50m — gives more time for trade-offs;
- Suggest pair-programming immediately after design so we keep cognitive momentum, but reduce it to 40m (we can split 10m follow-ups into the debrief).
- Can we move PM conversation to the 2nd half (after lunch)? PM folks prefer fresh context; Laura, any preference?
- Strongly recommend a 20–30m synchronous debrief immediately after the final interview (not just async) because we have split opinions in recent loops. Then everyone completes the rubric within 2 hours.

If we do that:
- 9:30–10:20 — System design (Karthik)
- 10:30–11:10 — Pair programming (Logan)
- 11:10–12:10 — Lunch/buffer
- 12:10–12:40 — PM (Laura)
- 12:45–13:30 — Infra deep-dive (Monica)
- 13:35–13:55 — Debrief (all)

I'll take primary debrief facilitation; Marissa, can you send the calendar slot and Zoom link?

—Karthik

2) Push infra to 13:00, PM at 13:40 (shorter PM 25–30m), then 14:10 debrief 20m. This gives an extra buffer for timezones.
